title: Big suites, leaky seams
subtitle: Claude becomes an office, Gemini 4 Carbon lands everywhere, and three AI vendors leak
editor_note: Claude grew into an office suite and Gemini 4 Carbon landed in every tool at once. The breaches came in at the seams: an inference vendor, a serving engine, a build system.

sections.headline: Claude moves into the whole office
sections.deck: Whiteboards, Sheets and Data, inside one chat.
sections.why: Your plans, trackers and charts can now live where your agent already works.

items.headline: One free full Claude reset
items.why: All models and limits, once. Expires Dec 11, 7:00 JST.

items.headline: Gemini 4 Carbon is out
items.why: Google’s top model for long agent work; 60.4% on CursorBench at high effort.

items.headline: Git: recursive clone can run code
items.why: CVE-2026-111760 via submodule hooks. Update Git in every sandbox.

items.headline: Grok Bot joins your tailnet
items.why: An outside agent can now sit on your Tailscale network. Scope its ACLs.

sections.deck: The breaches came in through the vendors.

sections.headline: Three AI vendors, one weak seam

items.label: Fireworks AI
items.note: Billing data, datasets and partial weights, via a cloud provider.
items.why: First reported as secrets only; it grew.

items.label: Notion
items.note: AI chat transcripts exposed; Insights off, Fireworks dropped.
items.why: Your SaaS data travels to vendors you never chose.

items.label: NEAR AI
items.note: An SGLang RCE gave access to 18 agents and ~100 accounts.
items.why: The open-source serving engine was the door.

items.label: Railway
items.note: Postmortem: stolen AI keys ran up $740,000.
items.why: New since October: the bill, and what was taken.

sections.headline: Paranoia, in hindsight
sections.deck: Slow security looks cheap after a month like this.

sections.quote: But after seeing all the crazy security incidents at other AI inference providers, I’m grateful we take security so seriously.
